pfd_gp24.t: Bernadette Greene-Placentia — Candidate report, filing year 2024 — Clerk of the U.S. House (Jan. 17, 2025)

checks.legal: CourtListener and Justia could not be searched directly: the network proxy refuses both hosts and the fetch tool refuses unsearched URLs (Oct. 14, 2026). A site-restricted web search of courtlistener.com/justia.com was run instead, plus news searches. News searches on the candidate's name (Oct. 14, 2026) found no lawsuit, charge, lien or judgment.
checks.foreign: 2024 House candidate report read directly: no assets, no foreign income. FARA: exact-name search of the FARA bulk files (registrants, short forms, foreign principals), Oct. 13, 2026: no match.
checks.claims: Campaign site refused by fetch tool. Sample = checkable claims from her Ballotpedia surveys, her campaign-launch bio (Alliance Times-Herald) and the June 2026 debate (KTAR). 6 rated: 1 true, 5 unverifiable. The campaign publishes few checkable claims in sources reachable.
checks.democracy: Never in office. News search (AZPM/FOX 10 primary-debate listings) found no statement on the 2020 or 2024 results.

networth.note: No reportable assets; one liability. From the filing-year-2024 candidate report (Jan. 1, 2023–Dec. 18, 2024).

note.t: No reportable assets. Liability: medical bills owed to medical creditors from 2019–2022 ($50K–$100K). Household income is her spouse's Northrop Grumman pension ($13,800/yr), Social Security ($18,552) and temporary Maricopa County employment ($5,800). No positions, agreements or foreign income.

research_notes: Only a filing-year-2024 report is in the Clerk index; her 2026 committee reported $209,358 in receipts, so a 2025/2026 candidate report may be due or missing; needs a human check.
